app.title: Ruta CLF-C02 — Unofficial CLF-C02 exam prep

footer.local: Your progress is stored only in this browser (localStorage) and is never sent to any server.

home.subtitle: Preparation for the AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner (CLF-C02) exam, in two languages and at your own pace.
home.unofficial: Unofficial study tool. Not affiliated with or endorsed by AWS. Results are local study estimates.
home.howTitle: How do you want to study today?

study.title: Study Mode
study.intro: No timer. One question at a time, with immediate explanations for every answer.
study.hint: Show hint (does not affect your score)
study.registered: Answered questions have been recorded in your progress. They will reappear in Mistake Review if you got them wrong.

quiz.title: Quick Quiz
quiz.intro: The timer is advisory only: the quiz is not auto-submitted when time runs out. Explanations at the end.
quiz.autosave: Your answers are saved automatically. You can close and resume later from the home screen.

confirm.finishMsg: You have {n} unanswered question(s). Unanswered questions count as incorrect. Finish now?
confirm.importMsg: This will replace ALL current progress with the file contents. Continue?
confirm.clearMsg: Your progress, history, bookmarks and notes will be permanently deleted from this browser.
confirm.sureTitle: Are you sure you want to continue?
confirm.sureMsg: This action is permanent and cannot be undone. Consider exporting a backup first.

notify.timeUpAdvisory: Time is up. The timer is advisory only; you may continue.
notify.examAutoSubmitted: Time is up. The exam has been submitted automatically.

exam.title: Exam Simulation
exam.notice: Notice: this simulation is an unofficial study tool. It does not reproduce the real AWS exam or its scoring algorithm. Your result is a local study estimate.
exam.f2: 90 minutes of total time. When time runs out, the exam is submitted automatically.
exam.f3: Approximate domain distribution: D1 24% · D2 30% · D3 34% · D4 12%.
exam.f4: You can move forward and backward and flag questions for review.
exam.f5: Answers are revealed only at the end; unanswered questions count as incorrect; there is no penalty for guessing.
exam.partial: The verified question bank does not reach 65 yet; the simulation will run with the available count until the bank is complete.

results.title: Results
results.estimate: ⚠️ Local study estimate. The official exam uses scaled scoring (100–1000); this percentage does not equal the official score and does not guarantee your result.
results.weakHint: Review the related lessons and practice these topics again.

review.title: Review Mistakes
review.intro: Questions you got wrong stay here until you master them: they leave the active review list after 3 correct answers on separate days (full history is kept).
review.empty: You have no pending mistakes. Nice work! New incorrect questions will appear here.

bookmarks.title: Bookmarks and difficult questions
bookmarks.empty: You haven't saved any questions yet. Use the ☆ button during study to save them here.

dashboard.title: Your progress
dashboard.notice: These metrics reflect your local practice. They are not a prediction of your result on the official exam.
dashboard.weakTip: Tip: study each topic's lesson before retrying its questions.
dashboard.noQuizzes: Complete a quiz to see your history here.

lesson.whyExam: Why it matters for the exam

services.title: AWS service catalog
services.subtitle: Recommended learning level according to the CLF-C02 exam guide.
services.coreDesc: You should distinguish use cases and scenarios.
services.supportingDesc: You should know its purpose and category.
services.awarenessDesc: Recognize the service and its general purpose.

settings.title: Settings
settings.dataNotice: All your progress is stored only in this browser (localStorage). It is never sent to a server. Back it up by exporting to JSON.
settings.clearWarn: Progress, history, bookmarks and notes will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
settings.aboutText: Ruta CLF-C02 is an unofficial study tool for the AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner (CLF-C02) exam. It is not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by Amazon Web Services. "AWS" and service names are trademarks of Amazon.com, Inc.
settings.estimates: The app's percentages are local study estimates; the official exam uses scaled scoring.

boot.loadFailHint: If you opened the files directly from disk, serve the app with a local server, e.g.: npx http-server or python -m http.server.

learn.title: Learn
learn.intro: Cycle: learn → check understanding → practice → review mistakes → repeat. Pick a domain and advance lesson by lesson.
learn.checkIntro: Answer {n} questions about this lesson. You need {pct}% to pass.
learn.checkReviewNote: Review the explanations above before retrying.
learn.markVisitedNote: Reading the lesson does not equal mastering it: pass the check and answer correctly across separate days to master it.

recommend.title: Recommended for you
recommend.empty: All caught up. Keep it up!
recommend.topicErrors: Repeated mistakes in "{topic}" — review the lesson
recommend.domainReview: Low accuracy in D{d} ({pct}%) — review the domain

comparison.title: Comparison guides
comparison.subtitle: How to choose the right concept or service for a scenario.

flashcards.title: Flashcards
flashcards.subtitle: Key terms generated from the lessons. Flip the card and test your memory.

dashboardLessons.title: Lessons
dashboardLessons.summary: Completed: {completed} · Mastered: {mastered} · Needs review: {review} · In progress: {inProgress}

settingsExtra.checkThreshold: Threshold to pass a lesson's knowledge check (%)
settingsExtra.reviewDays: Days without review before a lesson is marked "needs review"
